PITB’s objective for the ICMS – District Case Management initiative is a secure, government-grade, district-level case/workflow automation platform that replaces manual and spreadsheet-based processes with an auditable, role-driven digital workflow. We understand success for PITB means: (i) web-based access through modern browsers, (ii) strong role-based access control to ensure each user only sees and performs what their designation allows, and (iii) a bilingual (English/Urdu) user experience that supports adoption at district offices.

We also understand that PITB is not only procuring software, but an end-to-end implementation: structured requirements confirmation, configuration/customization of workflows, controlled data migration from existing registers/Excel files, and practical training that enables district staff to operate the system confidently from day one. Our delivery approach is shaped by our experience delivering ISO 27001-governed platforms and infrastructure for government contexts, including federal cloud infrastructure deployments [CAP-012] and provincial government digital systems [CAP-046]. Our ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certifications support PITB’s expectations around information security management and quality-controlled delivery [CO-PROFILE].

We recognize the operational continuity requirement: a disaster recovery arrangement with RTO ≤ 4 hours, plus post-go-live maintenance and support with SLA-backed 99.5% uptime for three years, including at least 12 months of on-site technical support.

On compliance and submissions, we will follow PITB’s instructions for separate sealed technical/financial proposals, the hard/soft-copy packaging, and the stated timelines. TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is SECP incorporated and established in 2012, meeting the “minimum five years” registration requirement [CO-PROFILE].

Mandatory gap note: our evidence library does not yet evidence two CISSP (or equivalent) certified data security professionals; we will address this via named hiring/partnering before contract mobilization.
